review.intent_summary: Readiness diagnostics report supported, caution, or not_assessed based on the training pattern and calibration evidence.

criteria.criterion: Repeating seasonal structure with stable calibration can yield supported readiness.
Unstable declared seasonality or a drifting calibration center yields caution without making an otherwise completed run fail.
Insufficient calibration support yields not_assessed, including when the run otherwise completes.
Later evaluation changes do not rewrite the segment's training-and-calibration readiness assessment.

verification_evidence: Primary Codex agent inspected every declared implementation reference and compared acceptance criteria with current source and test assertions; this is a fresh semantic review, completed in the existing session.
Inspected spike readiness caution for residual autocorrelation and conversion not_assessed for three calibration samples; neither absence of findings nor a large score establishes alert accuracy.
